findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-readiness.ts:285 buildReviewGateRows does not mirror the real REVIEW→TEST gate for required active reviewer lanes. After any valid reviewer pass/finding exists, the readiness report only checks invalid bindings and open blocking findings, then emits no_open_blocking_review_findings at lines 335-344. The actual gate in packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:564-585 requires every opt-in reviewer lane in round 1 and quorum evaluation. This can make lifecycle_check report localReady or missing only validation while concept/quality/test-coverage lanes are still absent, violating the proof-or-stop contract and giving unsafe next-action guidance.
